'''The Works''', originally known as '''Sector 943''' and colloquially known as or the '''Flatlands''', was a large industrial area of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was located southwest of the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] and next to the [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi District]]. Sector 943 had been an immense manufacturing center for many companies, who would later abandon the planet for cheap labor and off-world facilities. Prospective urban developers released [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mites]], [[Duracrete slug/Legends|duracrete slugs]], and [[Conduit worm/Legends|conduit worms]] into the Works, in an attempt to clear the area out so it could be purchased and refurbished.

==Description==
The Works was a broad, flat industrial plain sited well below the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]]. To its far north the Works was overlooked by the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and the [[Pius Dea Spaceport]], and to its south by the [[resiblock]]s and commercial towers of the [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi District]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|The Senate is studying plans to develop housing projects in the flatlands.|Palpatine, to Dooku|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
[[File:Sith_lair_The_Works.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] meets with his [[Palpatine/Legends|Master]] in the LiMerge Building.]]
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Works were overrun by [[Cthon/Legends|Cthons]] and reprogramed [[Droid/Legends|droids]] who attacked anyone and everyone on site. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] also had a minor presence down in the Works.

After the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s successful [[War against Zakuul|Revolt against the Eternal Empire]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kallin]] based his forces in the Works and planned to use explosives to bomb the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] in an attempt to raise conflict and start war between the Republic and the Alliance. However, the [[Eternal Alliance Recon Unit]] managed to track him down and [[Battle in the Works|eliminate]] him to prevent war between the two major powers.

At the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] arrived at the Works to inform his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], that the war between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] had begun. The Dark Lord was pleased at the news, as it was a step closer to the completion of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]].<ref name="Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Sidious summoned Dooku back to the Works in response to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] presence on [[Korriban/Legends|Moraband]]. Initiating a Sith ritual using Dooku's [[Blood/Legends|blood]] to draw on his [[The Force/Legends|Force]] bond with his old Master and feeding it with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], they were able to draw the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] into an illusion in which he, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and a squad of clones from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]; including [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], were on their way to The Works to apprehend the Sith Lords. The intent of the deception was to break Yoda's spirit; however, the attempt failed.<ref name="Sacrifice (ep)">{{TCW|Sacrifice (episode)}}</ref>

Towards the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] working with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] traced the Separatists back to the [[LiMerge Power/Legends|LiMerge Power]] [[LiMerge Building/Legends|building]], a large tower in the center of The Works. Two squads infiltrated the building, [[Aurek Team]] led by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and [[Bacta Team]] led by [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]. It was soon verified that Count Dooku and possibly even the elusive Darth Sidious himself had used this location until recent times.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

Count Dooku spent much of his time in The Works mastering the teachings of the Sith. Even [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] was possibly trained in The Works. The area around the LiMerge Power building was littered with a small number of destroyed combat droids, all bisected with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

[[File:The_Works.png|thumb|right|250px|An underground [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] in The Works during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].]]
By this time The Works was an area to be avoided by most of the population, due to its usual inhabitants of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], squatters, [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] runners, malfunctioning [[Droid/Legends|droids]], gangsters, undocumented refugees, and [[Cthon/Legends|Cthons]]. The majority of The Works' structures were in a severe state of decay, and had been abandoned for centuries. Despite this, many of the facilities were self-powered and continued to produce toxic waste and eerie mechanical sounds across the low-lying factories for a long time after the departure of the owners.

The same area was later used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a manufacturing center for [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], producing hundreds of starfighters per day.<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030403coruscant1|series=Coruscant: Center of the Empire|text=Part 1: Bright Lights, Very Big City}}</ref> Towards the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] underground forces used this area as a staging ground for the eventual [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Works resembles a location in the Coruscant scenes in the alternate dark side ending of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. Note, however, that in ''Jedi Knight'', the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] appears instead of the [[LiMerge Power/Legends|LiMerge Power]] building.
